{{Top|leg}}
Extra '''sensor plates''' were fitted to the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to allow them better navigate the forests. They were mounted under the forward [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]] vanes and gave the [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] a clear image of the terrain ahead.
